name: Tear-out emphasis
description: Tear-out treatment with a circled mark and snap zoom toward the quote.

content.body: Trust the process. Most teams overweight the milestone announcement and underweight the daily standup; the announcement is performative, the standup is corrective. The teams that ship steadily over years almost always run the same boring rhythm, not because rhythm is glamorous, but because [highlight]rhythm exposes drift fast enough to be cheap[/highlight].
content.author: Internal memo
